content:
{'text': '已故戴安娜王妃的幼弟查理斯史賓沙在新書中指控，國王查理斯在戴妃於1997年不幸離世後曾揚言，世人很快就會將她遺忘。有關指控來自史賓沙即將出版的回憶書。', 'tr': "The late Princess Diana's younger brother, Charles Spencer, has alleged in a new book that King Charles said the world would quickly forget her after her death in 1997. The allegation comes from Spencer's forthcoming memoir."}

{'text': '《每日郵報》於周三公開的《天鵝之歌：我的姐姐戴安娜》（Swan Song: Diana, My Sister）摘錄中，史賓沙聲稱，他與現任國王當時曾就威廉王子和哈利王子應否在母親葬禮行列中步行送殯一事，發生激烈的爭拗。', 'tr': 'In excerpts from "Swan Song: Diana, My Sister" published by the Daily Mail on Wednesday, Spencer claimed he had a heated argument with the now-King over whether Princes William and Harry should walk in their mother\'s funeral procession.'}

{'text': '在這本將於下周出版的書中，史賓沙寫道：「查理斯王子繼續滔滔不絕地發洩怒火，期間我沒有打斷他，之後他停下來。」', 'tr': 'In the book, due out next week, Spencer wrote: "Prince Charles kept raging on, and I let him, and then he stopped."'}

{'text': '史賓沙續寫道：「我以為他停頓是想讓自己平復下來，豈料他隨即在電話中爆發，我一直認為他對戴安娜積壓已久的鄙視，以及對世人因她逝世而震驚不已的恐懼，都在此刻傾瀉而出。他咬牙切齒地說：『放心吧，我們很快就會把她忘得一乾二淨！』」', 'tr': 'Spencer continued: "I thought he was drawing breath, I thought he was going to calm down, but then he erupted. What I now know is that what was bubbling inside him, the contempt he bore her for years, the fear that the nation would be shocked to its core by her death, all came out then. Through gritted teeth he said: \'Don\'t worry, we\'ll soon forget about her.\'"'}

{'text': '史賓沙寫道，當時他被這番話「震驚得呆住了」，隔了幾秒才回應。', 'tr': 'Spencer wrote that he was "stunned into silence" by the remarks and took a few seconds to respond.'}

{'text': '他寫道：「我平靜地說：『我真不敢相信你會說出這種話。』說完便掛斷電話。」', 'tr': 'He wrote: "I said calmly: \'I can\'t believe you just said that.\' And I hung up."'}

{'text': '《每日郵報》周二報導，史賓沙新書的四本樣書在荷蘭被盜，目前荷蘭當局正就這宗爆竊案展開調查。', 'tr': "Four advance copies of Spencer's new book were stolen in the Netherlands, where authorities are investigating the burglary, the Daily Mail reported on Tuesday."}

{'text': '一名出版界消息人士形容這宗盜竊案「極其可疑」，並向該報表示：「從未發生過類似事件。」', 'tr': 'A publishing source described the theft as "deeply suspicious" and told the newspaper: "This has never happened before."'}

{'text': '他們告訴《每日郵報》：「這本很可能是今年最受矚目的書籍，圍繞它的保安措施一直非常嚴密。」', 'tr': 'They told the Daily Mail: "This is probably the most high-profile book of the year, and security around it has been very tight."'}

{'text': '史賓沙的發言人未即時回應《HuffPost》的置評請求。', 'tr': "A spokesperson for Spencer did not immediately respond to HuffPost's request for comment."}

{'text': '白金漢宮發言人回應《HuffPost》查詢時表示：「雖然按原則我們不會就書籍作出評論，但陛下明白手足之痛的哀傷有時會令人失去理智、影響判斷，並在多年後仍不自知地扭曲記憶。」', 'tr': 'A Buckingham Palace spokesperson responded to HuffPost\'s inquiry by saying: "While we wouldn\'t comment on books as a matter of principle, His Majesty understands the anguish of grief that can distort judgement and memory over many years."'}

{'text': '史賓沙在戴安娜於西敏寺舉行的喪禮上發表了動人的悼詞，猛烈抨擊英國小報為求新聞不擇手段，更形容她是「現代社會最受獵殺的人」。', 'tr': 'Spencer delivered a moving eulogy at Diana\'s funeral at Westminster Abbey, fiercely criticising the British tabloids for their ruthless pursuit of headlines and describing her as "the most hunted person of the modern age."'}

{'text': '史賓沙早前在社交媒體發文表示，即將出版的這本書是「過去三十年我所寫的十本書之中最私人、最貼心的一本」。', 'tr': 'In a social media post earlier, Spencer described the upcoming book as "the most personal and intimate of the ten books I have written over the last thirty years."'}

{'text': '他寫道：「這本書的核心，源於一個弟弟對一位非凡姐姐最真摯的緬懷。」', 'tr': 'He wrote: "At its heart, the book is a younger brother\'s loving tribute to an extraordinary sister."'}

{'text': '本報導由Carly Ledbetter參與製作。', 'tr': 'This report includes contributions from Carly Ledbetter.'}
